title: Autonickname
description: Add-on for Discord-Integration that uses Styled-Nicknames to Sync server Nicknames
body:
# AutoNickname

Add-on for [Discord-Integration](https://modrinth.com/project/rbJ7eS5V) that uses [styled-nicknames](https://modrinth.com/project/DOk6Gcdi) to automatically sync discord server nicknames with minecraft ones. 

## Important
[Discord-Integration](https://modrinth.com/project/rbJ7eS5V) requires addons to be placed in the 
`Server/DiscordIntegration-Data/addons` folder in order to be loaded properly. (This mod won't do anything if placed in the `Server/Mods` folder)
